"Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1831.

## Problem

`dev/dev-poll.sh` pre-lock merge scan (`pre-lock: scanning for mergeable PRs`, around the `PL_ISSUE` loop) calls `try_direct_merge` for an approved, CI-green PR assigned to `$BOT_USER` or unassigned. It never calls `issue_is_dev_claimable`. On success `try_direct_merge` merges the PR and `issue_close`s the linked issue.

This is a third path beside #1832 (`merge_ready_sweep` and the backlog `SKIP_LABEL` grep). It runs before the in-progress scan, so the #1825 stuck-PR skip never sees the PR. A hand-applied `awaiting-live-verification` (or any other `_ILC_NON_DEV_LABELS` label) does not stop it. Root `AGENTS.md` says dev-poll skips `awaiting-live-verification`.

Not introduced by PR #1831. The stuck-PR scan now skips non-dev labels before merge and spawn; this pre-lock path predates that skip.

## Failure mode

Hand-label a bot-assigned open issue `awaiting-live-verification` while its PR is approved and CI green. The next dev-poll tick can merge the PR and close the issue in the pre-lock scan, before the in-progress or stuck-PR skips run.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*
"

"Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1831.

## Problem

`issue_is_dev_claimable` (`lib/issue-lifecycle.sh`, `_ILC_NON_DEV_LABELS`, including a hand-applied `awaiting-live-verification`) is consulted only in the in-progress scan of `dev/dev-poll.sh`. Two other dev-poll paths still act on those issues. Root `AGENTS.md` says dev-poll skips `awaiting-live-verification`.

1. `dev/merge-ready.sh` `merge_ready_sweep()` (sourced at the start of every dev-poll tick) merges any open PR that is mergeable, review-bot APPROVED on HEAD, CI green, and past `MERGE_COOLDOWN_MIN`. It checks PR labels `blocked` / `do-not-merge` only. It does not read the linked issue's labels. On success it calls `issue_close` on the linked issue. A bot-assigned open issue that a human labeled `awaiting-live-verification` (or `vision`, `bug-report`, etc.) can therefore be merged and closed before the live check.

2. The backlog scan (`dev/dev-poll.sh`, around the `SKIP_LABEL` grep) skips `formula`, `prediction/dismissed`, `prediction/unreviewed`, `waiting-on-compute`, `experiment`, `run`, and `judgment` only. It does not call `issue_is_dev_claimable`. An issue that still carries `backlog` plus `awaiting-live-verification`, `vision`, `bug-report`, `action`, or `in-triage` can be claimed and spawned.

This is pre-existing. It is not the in-progress-scan fall-through into the stuck-PR scan (that hole is in scope for PR #1831 / #1825).

## Failure mode

Hand-label an open issue `awaiting-live-verification` while its PR is approved, CI green, and mergeable. The next dev-poll tick's merge-ready sweep can merge the PR and close the issue. Separately, a `backlog` issue with that label can be picked up as new work.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*
"
